svg.text: Ticketing API: AWS Serverless Architecture (Track C)
API Gateway (HTTP API) + AWS Lambda + Amazon DynamoDB · Diffie Alfierie Iswanto (533049) · Cloud Computing, Week 12
AWS Cloud: personal AWS account (Free plan)
Fully managed services on public AWS endpoints; every hop is HTTPS/TLS; no VPC or servers to manage
Least privilege: CRUD on Tickets table
+ write to its own log group only
Re-runnable (idempotent). infra/teardown.sh deletes everything (incl. IAM role and logs) after grading.
Cost when idle ≈ $0: all three services are pay-per-request (Free plan credits cover testing).
Client sends HTTPS request, e.g. POST /tickets + JSON body
API Gateway matches the route and invokes Lambda
Lambda validates input, calls DynamoDB with its execution-role credentials
DynamoDB returns the item(s) / write result
API Gateway sends the JSON response (201/200/204/400/404)
• TLS on every hop; no servers or open ports to secure
• Lambda resource policy restricts invoke to this API's ARN; least-privilege execution role
• Allow-listed fields + enum validation · planned: Cognito JWT authorizer
